title: Speculation
intro: Turn your face-down cards up one at a time — whoever holds the best trump at the end takes the pot
hiddenNotice: Nobody can see a face-down card. All you learn is how many are left
guide.yourTurn: Your turn — turn up one of your face-down cards
guide.sell: {{buyer}} offers {{amount}} for your best trump. Sell it?
guide.buy: {{owner}} will part with the best trump for {{amount}}. Buy it?
guide.raiseHint: A raise must be at least {{min}}
result.void: No trump appeared. The stakes are returned
tutorial.hidden: Each seat is dealt three face-down cards. Nobody sees them; all you learn is how many are left
tutorial.trump: One more card is turned from the deck to fix the trump suit. It belongs to nobody
tutorial.auction: When a card beats the best trump so far, an auction opens — sell, decline, or raise and buy
frontendHint.speculationFlip: Turn one up and see — there is still room to be outdone
frontendHint.speculationSell: Sell: plenty of cards are still face down, so this lead will likely be beaten
frontendHint.speculationHold: Hold: few cards remain, so this one may well take the pot
frontendHint.speculationBuy: Buy: few cards remain, so this one may well take the pot
frontendHint.speculationPass: Pass: plenty of cards are still face down, so a purchase could be beaten
